note:
R80 - gen7 codec-0x05 (EALayer3 v1) sources beyond the six measured pbp_eng sets: announcer banks, play-by-play on the unmeasured
trees, music banks and `.abk` sfx banks, surveyed by title / platform / rate / channel config / container, and the R77 grammar applied
per class on independent vectors (read-only; temporary rebuilt .mp3 / .wav in R80_SCRATCH, removed).

Per tree (16 gen7 roots) and class:
  speech `pbp_eng` (trees NOT in the R77 set) and `ann_eng` (all): SBKR + .sbs (loose or archive, as r28 locates them), 4 vectors
      (first / last / two spaced distinct offsets): SNR codec / rate / channel config / type; codec 0x05 -> R77 parse of every block
      (tiling, granule rule incl. the first-block +2 and the PCM frame position), rebuild + ffmpeg decode when mono (stereo: parse only);
  music `music_samples` (loose audio/music or archive member): SBKR + .sbs, 3 vectors, same tests;
  sfx `.abk` (`000_goal.abk`, `000_chant.abk`, `sfx.abk` when loose): ABKC S10A sample table, first 3 entries: SNR words, then the raw
      codec stream (no SNS block framing, per the 2026-09-20 handoff 02) parsed as ONE block with the R77 grammar.
  Malformed input (one codec-0x05 vector per class): last block truncated by 3 bytes; flag byte set to 0x01; the PCM frame's count
      overwritten with 4096; every mutation must be refused by the parser (T5). Reservoir / count: rebuild asserts main_data_begin
      <= 511 / 255; granules x 576 vs num_samples recorded.
Results are per (tree, class, rate, channel config): 'established' only when every vector tiles, the granule rule holds, and the rebuild
decodes to granules x 576 samples; otherwise the exact failure. Successful ffmpeg exit alone is never the criterion.
Usage: python r80_gen7_codec05_survey.py <out.json> [--trees a,b] [--keep]
